assumptions: A1 F1/F3 year result = change of end-of-day equity in the calendar year (s3 "years from daily equity"); s6.1 net=profit+commission+swap is applied literally to F2; F1/F3 closed-deal net per year is reported.
A2 Valid year = real ticks >=99% (s4). Required positive years = valid-1 (6/7 or 5/6); <6 valid -> DATA-FAIL. Quality missing -> INCOMPLETE.

A3 s6.3 stress: 0.5*unit*lots*value_per_point per deal (=1 unit per round trip); unit FX 0.0001, IDX max(1.0,1bp), XAU max(0.10,1bp) of deal price. Pass = total >0 AND #valid years with stressed result >0 >= required years of s6.1. F2 total over valid years; F1/F3 whole run.

A4 F1/F3 DD: peak of end-of-day equity vs trough=min(intraday-min equity if supplied, EOD equity); gate uses that (conservative), EOD-only reported. F2 DD = report "equity DD %" per annual run, all valid years <=15%; if missing, closed-trade DD used + flag.
A5 DE40 (EUR, no FX conversion in EA): DD gated on DD/EURUSD (EURUSD from spec or value_per_point/contract_size); raw reported; if not derivable, raw DD gated.

A6 s6.5 gross<=3.0 "at every moment": checked after every exposure-increasing deal (notional=lots*price*value_per_point, equity=balance+unrealized at deal price), +2% tolerance for lot rounding; drift between rebalances not observable/not gated.
A7 s6.4 top-10 days: F2 daily closed net over valid years; F1/F3 daily change of EOD equity over the whole run. Net<=0 -> fail.
A8 s6.6 hold = position episode flat->flat (C1: first opening deal until position zero; reversal = close+open).

A9 s6.7 F2 expectancy = mean over trades of net/(lots*value_per_pip); F1/F3 bp = closed-deal net / sum of entry notional (volume that increases |position|). Cost ratio = (|sum swap|+|sum commission|)/sum gross profit; gross<=0 -> fail.

A10 s6.8 trade loss <=3% of balance before entry (F2 only, as written); worst day <=5% all: F2 day closed net / balance at day start; F1/F3 EOD equity change / previous EOD equity (intraday-min version reported).
A11 s4 swap screen: annual swap COST of long and of short each <=10% (mode 5/6 = %/yr; points: pts*point*365/price; money: money/(contract*price)*365). Positive swap is not a cost.
A12 s6.10 correlations need ref_daily_*.csv (date,ret|pnl|equity) in the data dir; absent -> UNKNOWN; PASS stays PASS with note.
A13 BD crash days = 33 unique server dates of the 59 t379 events (5 t391 windows reported separately); F3 flag if sum <0.
A14 F3 regime flag: equity change 2024-2026 / 2020-2026 >0.5 (total >0).
A15 Monthly: F1/F3 geometric mean of month-end equity returns; F2 closed-trade months, each annual run restarting at 120K (t404), also x0.5.

A16 Pre-screen failure computed from spec_t405.json -> COST-EXCLUDED even if a run exists (counts in K). Missing spec field -> UNKNOWN (reported, not excluded). summary COST/DATA-EXCLUDED list honoured.
A17 F2 DST: spec says server follows US DST -> LDN variants DATA-EXCLUDED; DST check missing/unclear -> LDN INCOMPLETE.
